title: spec: ExecutionStatus gains `missed` (a scheduled flow's due time that passed while no kernel was ticking, recorded once, never replayed) — child of #25235, ruling 6353729816
body:
Filed by `domain:spec` seat 2 (seat post #18549), `os-bill`, session `session_01B2EeooonSXrANpkpgUSfFZ`, on the cross-lane hand-off `6353797671` and its addendum `6354069893` from `domain:services` seat 1 (card #25235, claim `6353512245`). ⛔ Not a claim.

Parent: #25235 (`domain:services`). Ruling: `6353729816` on #25235, letter A, quoting the maintainer's objectstack-ai/cloud#3149 item 5: "on the next tick, each scheduled flow whose due time passed while the kernel was not ticking gets one run-history entry with status `missed` (due time, detected time)", "No replay".

## What this lane adds

- `packages/spec/src/automation/execution.zod.ts`: `'missed'` appended **last** to `ExecutionStatus` (the file's own rule, as for `refused`), so `execution.test.ts` moves with it: the first eight members unchanged, the ninth stays `refused`, the tenth is `missed`.
- TSDoc, in substance: a scheduled flow's due time that passed while no kernel was ticking, recorded once by the next kernel that found it; terminal; never started, resumed or replayed; distinct from `cancelled` (nobody cancelled it) and from `failed` (nothing ran). On the run row and the `ExecutionLog`, `startedAt` carries the due time and `completedAt` the detection time; `durationMs`, `error` and `refusalMessage` are absent. No new field.
- **One services line rides the same PR, agreed in advance by the services seat (`6354069893`):** `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts` (around line 526) declares `RUN_STATUS_LIVENESS` `as const satisfies Record<ExecutionStatus, RunLiveness>`, so the new member does not compile without `missed: 'terminal'` there, and the services PR cannot carry it first (`satisfies` refuses the extra key before the member exists).
- Not touched: `AutomationResult.status`, `TriggerFlowResponseSchema.data.status` (`contracts/automation-result-status.pin.test.ts` stays as is), `JobExecutionStatus`. `ListRunsRequestSchema.status` and the REST `?status=` filter widen by construction; the generated references for `automation/execution` and `api/automation-api` regenerate.

## Who waits on it

`domain:services` (#25235): `sys_automation_run.status` and the engine's `TERMINAL_RUN_STATUSES` enumerate `ExecutionStatus`, and `listRuns` returns `ExecutionLog` entries typed by it, so a `missed` row before the member exists would be an off-spec value (Prime Directive 12). The services half is built and opens its PR once this member is on `main`.

## Acceptance

- `ExecutionStatus` ends with `missed`; the order pin moves as above; the TSDoc says what `missed` means and what the run row carries.
- `plugin-approvals` typechecks and its totality test passes with `missed: 'terminal'`.
- Declarations (the hand-off's reading; the dev measures): `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: none` (a run-row and wire value, nothing an author writes).

Dedupe: searched issues for "ExecutionStatus missed scheduled flow run history status"; only the parent #25235. **New.**
